name: Freeing A Slave
overview: Scripture addresses the practice of slavery with clear distinctions between the treatment of bondmen and the freedom of Hebrew servants. While Leviticus permits acquiring servants from surrounding nations, Deuteronomy commands that Hebrew slaves be released after six years of service. Christ’s redemptive work offers true and lasting freedom beyond physical bondage, as stated in John 8:36. Additionally, Colossians reminds masters to act justly and fairly toward their servants, recognizing their accountability to God.
